description: Google Maps for Power BI brings the full power of Google Maps into your Power BI reports so you can explore, segment, and filter location-based data in a familiar, high-performance map experience. Use it for territory analysis, store/branch performance, field operations, real estate portfolios, risk mapping, and any scenario where "where" matters. Popular use cases: Sales & Territory Management: coverage gaps, territory performance, "what’s inside this zone?" Retail / Store Locator & Performance: store catchment areas, competitor places nearby Logistics / Field Service: radius-based operations, dispatch areas, regional workload Real Estate: listings on a map, radius searches, neighborhood analysis Insurance / Risk: exposure by region, density patterns, zone-based analysis Why teams choose this visual: Interactive mapping inside Power BI for real analysis (not just dots on a map) Map-based filtering: focus on the exact area and analyze only what’s inside Built for scale: handle datasets above 30,000 rows with the "Very Large Dataset" option Core features: Category colors & legend filtering to segment points fast Circle & polygon filtering to analyze specific zones/territories Clustering for dense areas and large volumes Heatmap layer to spot concentration and hotspots instantly Street View and 3D View for better location context Address Search and Google Places Search (by…
